p1: Esther sent a message to Mordecai. “Gather all the Jews here, and fast for me for three days. My helpers and I will fast too.”
When people fast, they go without food and drink for a little while. It shows Heavenly Father how much they need His help.
Esther said, “Then I will go to the king, even against the rule.”
p2: On the third day, Esther put on her royal clothes. She stood in the king’s courtyard. The king was pleased to see her! He held out his golden scepter, a gold stick that meant welcome. Esther touched the top.
Esther was brave, and her people fasted with her. Tonight, think of someone who needs help, and ask Heavenly Father to bless them.
old: Esther decided to be brave and help her people. But first, she wanted Heavenly Father’s help.
She asked everyone to fast and pray with her for three whole days. “Then I will go to the king,” she said, “and if I perish, I perish.” That means she would be brave no matter what.
After praying, Esther put on her royal robe and walked bravely to the king. Her heart was probably beating fast, but she kept going.
The king smiled and welcomed her! He held out his golden scepter, which meant, “Come closer, I’m happy to see you.” Heavenly Father had helped brave Esther every step of the way.
